Behavior delta, accepted: createIdempotencyKey (BaseAPI.ts:21-25) has no typeof crypto guard and no Math.random fallback, unlike the removed generator. Every target runtime (browser, Capacitor WebView, bun) has globalThis.crypto, and the getRandomValues branch covers insecure contexts that lack randomUUID, so the ids are stronger. Queue entry ids change from UUID or q_* to UUID or 32-hex. isValidEntry (RequestQueue.ts:48-55) only needs a string id, so persisted entries still load. The Laravel IdempotentRequest middleware hashes the key and puts no format limit on it.

RequestQueue.ts now depends on the Laravel transport module BaseAPI.ts, whose imports include logStore, AuthSession and persistence. There is no cycle, and MasterApiClient already imported BaseAPI in D1, so the bundle gains no module. A later move of IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_HEADER and createIdempotencyKey into a transport-neutral leaf module (for example under core/network/) would decouple the end-agnostic api-client layer from the Laravel transport. CKA-12 does not require it.
